import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np, json
from lsbuild import gelu, layer_data, build_l5_mixed
from evalh import Lb, lab1, f1
def LN(x,g,b): mu=x.mean(1,keepdims=True); v=x.var(1,keepdims=True); return (x-mu)/np.sqrt(v+1e-5)*g+b
pre='roberta.encoder.layer.5.'
ab,W1,b1,U,b2=layer_data(5,base)
g2=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); bb=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
D=base('classifier.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bd=base('classifier.dense.bias'); O=base('classifier.out_proj.weight'); bo=base('classifier.out_proj.bias')
head=lambda h: np.tanh(h@D.T+bd)@O.T+bo
ae=np.load('a5e_1792.npy').astype(np.float64); ae6=np.load('a5e_1536.npy').astype(np.float64)
Gb=gelu(ab@W1.T+b1); Ge=gelu(ae@W1.T+b1); Ge6=gelu(ae6@W1.T+b1); xb=ab+Gb@U.T+b2
# ids used in token LS fits
p2=json.load(open('pass_2/meta.json'))['ids']; p3=json.load(open('probe2_ids.json'))
used=set(p2)|set(p3 if isinstance(p3,list) else p3['ids']); 
ids=[f"p{i:04d}" for i in range(1000)]; hold=np.array([i not in used for i in ids]); print('holdout n',hold.sum())
pb=Lb.argmax(1); srt=np.sort(Lb,1); marg=srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]; i2=np.argsort(Lb,1)[:,-2]
def rep(name,h):
    L=head(h); pe=L.argmax(1); fl=pe!=pb
    dm=(L[np.arange(1000),pb]-L[np.arange(1000),i2])-marg
    print('%-28s agree %.3f (hold %.4f) flips %d R->W %d acc %.3f F1 %.4f dm std %.3f low %.3f'%(name,(~fl).mean(),(~fl)[hold].mean(),fl.sum(),(fl&(pb==lab1)).sum(),(pe==lab1).mean(),f1(pe,lab1),dm.std(),dm[marg<1].std()))
rep('full FFN', LN(ae+Ge@U.T+b2,g2,bb))
folds=np.load('folds.npy')
def fit(Xs,Ts,m,lam):
    X=np.vstack(Xs);T=np.vstack(Ts)
    mu=X.mean(0); tm=T.mean(0); Xc=X-mu
    sc=(U**2).sum(0)*(Xc**2).sum(0); keep=np.sort(np.argsort(-sc)[:m])
    Xk=Xc[:,keep]; R=(T-tm)-Xk@U[:,keep].T
    Dd=np.linalg.solve(Xk.T@Xk+lam*np.eye(m),Xk.T@R).T
    Un=U[:,keep]+Dd; return keep,Un,tm-Un@mu[keep]
for m in [1536,1792]:
    for lam in [3,10,30]:
        keep,Un,b2n=fit([Gb],[xb-ab],m,lam)   # base-only uses no edited data -> honest on ae
        rep(f'base-only m{m} lam{lam}', LN(ae+Ge[:,keep]@Un.T+b2n,g2,bb))
    # mixed with a5e_1536 / a5e_1792, CV by item folds
    for src,GE,AE in [('mix1536',Ge6,ae6),('mix1792',Ge,ae)]:
        H=np.zeros_like(xb)
        for f in range(10):
            tr=folds!=f; te=folds==f
            keep,Un,b2n=fit([Gb[tr],GE[tr]],[xb[tr]-ab[tr],xb[tr]-AE[tr]],m,30)
            H[te]=LN(ae[te]+Ge[te][:,keep]@Un.T+b2n,g2,bb)
        rep(f'{src} CV m{m} lam30',H)
